{{Quote|Father, this is my Initiation Hunt. You can't keep my wings pinioned forever.|translated=1|[[Kharys]], to [[Klarymére]]|<ref name="swcw">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
